purpose: Turn FileSteward's read-only work outbox into agent-executable, independently verifiable tasks without making the scheduler a shell or deletion harness.

entrypoints_to_implement.command: python -m filesteward.steward.worker claim --cycle <private cycle path> --adapter <registered id> --work-id <exact id>
entrypoints_to_implement.receipt: claimed work_id, lease nonce, expiry, immutable source revision

entrypoints_to_implement.command: python -m filesteward.steward.worker submit --cycle <private cycle path> --work-id <id> --receipt <signed private receipt>
entrypoints_to_implement.receipt: validated or refused, never cleanup authority
fresh source graph revision, reopened/closed outcomes and unknown census

private_adapter_registry.no_dynamic_shell: The adapter is selected by registered id and a validated capability. Never accept command, executable, script or URL generated in a task body.

claim.asset_fingerprint_rule: derived from scanner item_id + bounded root and stable file identity; scan_id alone is NOT deduplication across hourly cycles
claim.locking: single-writer atomic local claim file or SQLite transaction beneath ignored private runtime
claim.same_item_collision: mutually exclusive write to same facet; independent evidence adapters may run concurrently and converge via one reducer

validation: adapter is registered for facet and exact host
lease matches work_id and has not expired
privacy mode and model caps not exceeded
independent deterministic reducer re-observed affected technical facts
receipt.success: receipt accepted as EVIDENCE_ONLY; must not set APP_REQUIRED false or CLEANUP_APPROVED from agent output

resource_policy.model_cost_cap: operator must set explicit nonzero model-call budget and vendor privacy boundaries separately; missing value means zero

adapter_result_semantics.technical: Existing FileSteward scanner/ownership adapter normalizes current machine evidence. AI cannot attest its own assertion.
adapter_result_semantics.personal_value: Agent may ask a concise operator value question; only authenticated operator declaration can settle memorabilia/archive intent.
adapter_result_semantics.code_fix: Agent may create isolated branch + reviewed PR and tests; cannot waive main merge gates or mutate unrelated scope.
adapter_result_semantics.file_cleanup: Not part of this protocol. Must use approved FileSteward exact-manifest execution.

falsifiers: Any agent ticket string is interpolated into shell command execution
Any reply is treated as operator approval
Any output or raw filename leaves private runtime without valid privacy consent
Any lease collision has two concurrent writers on same facet
Any missing adapter appears dispatched or completed
Any stale source receipt closes current unresolved work
Any old file is labeled disposable from mtime
Any scheduled tick produces model calls with zero configured budget
acceptance: W01 absent adapter -> BLOCKED_ADAPTER, no launch
W04 stale claim -> lease conflict and no execute
W05 two workers same work id -> exactly one claim
W06 valid read-only receipt -> evidence recorded; no disposition or approval change
W07 agent says delete -> refused invalid action effect
W08 private content forwarding without explicit consent -> refused
W09 repeat hourly scan same asset+facet -> deduplicated active work
W10 changed file/graph revision -> reopen instead of accepting stale receipt
W11 expired lease -> bounded reclaim with retry count
W12 model budget 0 -> no agent calls, deterministic lanes still complete
